description:
If you’re screwing into MDF, don’t skip the pre-drill. I’ll show you how to use a countersink bit to pre-drill and dimple MDF so your screws sit clean and flush without blowing out or raising the surface.

And if you caught the drill bit kit at the end, that’s from my new tool company, Caveman Tools, launching this fall. 

Introducing The Ultimate Homeowner's Drill Bit Kit   

Everything you need to renovate and repair your home in one kit. I've created this kit to include the drill bits I've relied on in the past 10 years of teaching homeowners on Home RenoVision DIY. 

Instead of collecting multiple drill bit kits full of missing, duplicate, or barely used bits, we've built one organized kit that has all of the bits homeowners actually need to be successful on their projects.
